screen.index_lead: Send a spreadsheet or a CSV to add records in bulk, or download what is already stored.
screen.overview_empty_lead: When you are allowed to import or export, the options show up here.
screen.upload_lead: CSV and Excel (.xlsx) are accepted, with or without a heading row. Choose the file and press Review file: nothing is saved until you confirm.
screen.upload_prompt: Drop the spreadsheet here or click to choose the file
screen.upload_hint: CSV or Excel (.xlsx), up to :mb MB and :rows rows.
screen.model_lead: Download the template, fill it in and send it. The order of the columns does not matter when the heading row is in the file.
screen.history_empty_lead: Imports and exports of this space show up here.
screen.export_lead: Builds a file with everything stored. It is ready in moments and deleted after :days days.
screen.preview_lead: Nothing has been saved yet. See what we understood from the file and confirm to import.
screen.preview_header_yes: The first row was read as the heading.
screen.preview_header_no: The file has no heading: the columns were read in the template's order.
screen.problems_more: and :n more rows. The full report is available after the import.
screen.problems_more_report: and :n more rows. Download the report to see them all.
screen.confirm_lead: The ready rows will be saved in the background. You can leave this page: the import goes on.
screen.confirm_none: No row is ready to import. Fix the file and send it again.
screen.keep_note: The file is deleted after :days days.
screen.done_export_lead: :rows rows in the file. It is deleted after :days days.
screen.discarded_lead: The file was deleted and nothing was saved.
screen.refused_lead: Fix these rows and send only them again.
screen.files_gone: The files of this run were already deleted.

validation.file_format: Send a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file.
validation.file_xls: The old .xls format is not accepted. In Excel, use Save as and choose .xlsx or CSV.
validation.file_corrupt: This file could not be read. Check that it opens in your program and save it again as .xlsx or CSV.
validation.file_no_rows: The file has no data rows.
validation.columns_missing: The file lacks the required column: :columns.
validation.too_many_rows: Send up to :max rows at a time.
validation.file_gone: The file of this import was already deleted. Send it again.

failure.file_gone: We could not read the file that was sent. Send it again.
failure.write: The import stopped on an error of ours. What went in was kept; send the file again to finish.
failure.export_large: There are too many rows for one file.
failure.export_failed: We could not build the file. Try again.
failure.definition: This list no longer accepts export.
